xs, rs = psf.regen.contour.generate_contour(
    V_c=1.5e-3,         # Chamber volume [m³]
    AR_c=1.5,           # Chamber aspect ratio [-]
    r_t=0.025,          # Throat radius [m]
    area_ratio=8,       # Nozzle area ratio [-]
    nozzle="rao",
    R_1f=1, R_2f=2, R_3f=0.3,
)
contour = psf.regen.Contour(xs, rs, name="Contour")
wall = psf.regen.Wall(material=psf.common.solids.StainlessSteel304, thickness=0.8e-3)

def build_chamber(helix_angle):
    circuit = psf.regen.CoolingCircuit(
        name="Cooling Pass",
        contour=contour,
        coolant_transport=None,
        cross_section=psf.regen.CrossSectionSquared(sidewall_half_thickness=0.5e-3),
        span=[1.0, -1.0],
        placement=psf.regen.SurfacePlacement(n_channel_positions=40, helix_angle=helix_angle),
        walls=[wall],
        roughness=10e-6,
        channel_height=2e-3,
    )
    return psf.regen.ThrustChamber(
        contour=contour,
        combustion_transport=None,
        cooling_circuits=[circuit],
        n_nodes=400,
    )

x_stations = np.asarray(build_chamber(0.0).cooling_circuits[0].x_domain)

def tabulated_helix(cos_gamma):
    """Helix law interpolating cos(gamma) tabulated on the stations [rad]."""
    def helix_angle(x):
        return float(np.arccos(np.interp(x, x_stations, cos_gamma)))
    return helix_angle

def coolant_area(cos_gamma):
    """Coolant area at every station for a tabulated helix [m²]."""
    chamber = build_chamber(tabulated_helix(cos_gamma))
    return np.asarray(chamber.cooling_circuits[0].A_coolant_vals)

cos_a = np.ones_like(x_stations)             # axial channel
A_a = coolant_area(cos_a)
A_target = A_a.min()                         # narrowest axial area, at the throat

cos_b = np.full_like(x_stations, np.cos(np.radians(30.0)))
A_b = coolant_area(cos_b)

while np.abs(A_b - A_target).max() > 1e-6 * A_target:
    # One secant step per station, all stations from the same build.
    # A station that has stopped moving takes no step.
    step = (A_b - A_target) * (cos_b - cos_a) / np.where(A_b != A_a, A_b - A_a, np.inf)
    cos_a, A_a = cos_b, A_b
    cos_b = np.clip(cos_b - step, 0.0, 1.0)
    A_b = coolant_area(cos_b)
    print(f"max area error: {np.abs(A_b - A_target).max() / A_target:.1e}")

def make_params():
    """Return the editable input set for this example."""

    params = dict(
        # Core engine parameters
        p_c=100e5,
        p_e=0.8e5,
        MR=2.8,
        AR_c=2.0,
        F=100e3,

        # Fuel/oxidizer parameters
        cea_fu=psf.thermo.Fluid(type="fuel", propellants=["CH4"], fractions=[1.0]),
        cea_ox=psf.thermo.Fluid(type="oxidizer", propellants=["O2"], fractions=[1.0]),
        coolprop_fu=psf.thermo.Fluid(type="fuel", propellants=["methane"], fractions=[1.0],),
        coolprop_ox=psf.thermo.Fluid(type="oxidizer", propellants=["oxygen"], fractions=[1.0],),
        T_gas_fu_in=300,  # Adjusted to fall within NASA CEA tables
        T_gas_ox_in=300,

        # Propellant tanks
        p_tank_ox=5e5,
        p_tank_fu=5e5,

        # Chamber/nozzle parameters
        theta_conv=35,
        R_1f=1.0,
        R_2f=1.5,
        R_3f=0.5,
        length_fraction=1.0,  # 80 % nozzle
        L_star=1.1,

        # Cooling channels
        copper_roughness_height=0.0030e-3,
        fuel_channel_count=140,
        nozzle_channel_count=50,
        channel_rib_blockage=0.1,
        fuel_hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier=1.0,
        ox_outbound_hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier=1.2,
        ox_return_hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier=1.2,
        fuel_throat_channel_height=2.0e-3,
        fuel_channel_height_slope=6.0e-3,
        ox_channel_height=6e-3,
        ox_single_pass_channel_height=2.5e-3,

        # All cooling circuits use the same uncoated copper wall.
        copper_thickness=0.6e-3,

        # Materials
        copper=psf.common.solids.GRCop42,

        # Pump parameters. This cycle carries no volute, disk friction or
        # bearing model, so the impeller's hydraulic efficiency is the only
        # loss the pumps are charged and stands in for all of them.
        eta_pump_fu=0.72,
        n_fu=50000,  # rpm
        eta_pump_ox_stage1=0.76,
        eta_pump_ox_stage2=0.72,
        n_ox=25000,  # rpm

        # Turbine efficiencies
        eta_turbine_fu=0.75,
        eta_turbine_ox=0.72,

        # Duct pressure ratios: fuel side
        eta_pump_regen_fu=0.95,
        eta_regen_turbine_fu=0.98,
        eta_turbine_injector_fu=0.94,
        eta_fu_injector=0.88,

        # Duct pressure ratios: oxidizer side
        eta_pump_regen_ox=0.98,
        eta_regen_turbine_ox=0.98,
        eta_turbine_injector_ox=0.88,
        eta_ox_injector=0.88,

        # Mass-flow leakage fractions
        zeta_fu_recirc=0.005,
        zeta_ox_recirc=0.005,
        ox_regen_flow_fraction=0.4,
        zeta_fu_turbine_bypass=0.005,
        zeta_ox_turbine_bypass=0.005,

        # Standalone regeneration-analysis boundary conditions, used in regen_only mode. 
        T_regen_fu_in=111.0,
        p_regen_fu_in=150e5,
        T_regen_ox_in=93.0,
        p_regen_ox_in=150e5,
    )

    # Derived tank properties used by the full-cycle initial guesses.
    params["T_tank_ox"] = CP.PropsSI("T", "P", params["p_tank_ox"], "Q", 0, params["coolprop_ox"].propellants[0],)
    params["T_tank_fu"] = CP.PropsSI("T", "P", params["p_tank_fu"], "Q", 0, params["coolprop_fu"].propellants[0],)

    return params

def setup_thrust_chamber(params):
    """Build the chamber geometry, walls, channels, and gas-side transport."""

    aerothermodynamics = psf.thermo.Aerothermodynamics.from_F_pe_Lstar(
        fu=params["cea_fu"],
        ox=params["cea_ox"],
        T_fu_in=params["T_gas_fu_in"],
        T_ox_in=params["T_gas_ox_in"],
        MR=params["MR"],
        p_c=params["p_c"],
        F=params["F"],
        p_e=params["p_e"],
        L_star=params["L_star"],
        p_amb=1e5,
        minimum_cea_temperature=305.0,
    )

    xs, rs = psf.regen.contour.generate_contour(
        V_c=aerothermodynamics.V_c,
        r_t=aerothermodynamics.r_t,
        area_ratio=aerothermodynamics.eps,
        AR_c=params["AR_c"],
        theta_conv=params["theta_conv"],
        nozzle="rao",
        R_1f=params["R_1f"],
        R_2f=params["R_2f"],
        R_3f=params["R_3f"],
        length_fraction=params["length_fraction"],
    )
    contour = psf.regen.Contour(xs, rs, name="Methane Engine")

    copper_wall = psf.regen.Wall(
        material=params["copper"],
        thickness=params["copper_thickness"],
    )

    def fuel_channel_height(x):
        return (
            params["fuel_throat_channel_height"]
            + params["fuel_channel_height_slope"] * abs(x)
        )

    ox_outbound_span = (0.11, 1.0)
    ox_return_span = (1.0, 0.21)

    def span_fraction_to_x(span_fraction):
        if span_fraction >= 0.0:
            return span_fraction * float(contour.xs[-1])
        return span_fraction * -float(contour.xs[0])

    ox_outbound_bounds = tuple(map(span_fraction_to_x, ox_outbound_span))
    ox_return_bounds = tuple(map(span_fraction_to_x, ox_return_span))
    ox_overlap_start = max(min(ox_outbound_bounds), min(ox_return_bounds))

    def ox_channel_height(x):
        if x < ox_overlap_start:
            return params["ox_single_pass_channel_height"]
        return params["ox_channel_height"]

    cross_section_squared = psf.regen.CrossSectionSquared(
        sidewall_half_thickness=(1e-3) / 2,
    )

    cross_section_rounded = psf.regen.CrossSectionRounded(height_input="base", exposure_angles={"floor": 112 * np.pi / 180})
    fuel_transport = psf.thermo.FluidTransport(params["coolprop_fu"])
    ox_transport = psf.thermo.FluidTransport(params["coolprop_ox"])

    # An area-preserving helix.
    #
    # A squared section holds A = h * [(pi*cos(gamma)/n) * (2*r_base + h) - rib],
    # so with the channel height, rib width and channel count fixed, the area is
    # constant exactly when cos(gamma) * (2*r_base + h) is. Anchoring that
    # product where the nozzle circuits begin pins the helix at 20 deg there and
    # opens it out as the nozzle radius grows, instead of letting the passage
    # swell with the wall it wraps.
    # The law is written against the nozzle's design height rather than the
    # local one. Both ox circuits share this placement, and the analytical
    # layout requires them to follow a single angular evolution, so the helix
    # must not depend on anything that differs between them.
    helix_start_x = min(ox_outbound_bounds)
    helix_design_height = params["ox_channel_height"]
    helix_reference = np.cos(np.radians(20.0)) * (
        2.0
        * (
            contour.r(helix_start_x)
            + float(copper_wall.thickness(helix_start_x))
        )
        + helix_design_height
    )

    def area_preserving_helix(r, t_wall):
        """Return the helix angle that holds the coolant area constant [rad]."""
        return float(np.arccos(np.clip(helix_reference / (2.0 * (r + t_wall) + helix_design_height), -1.0, 1.0,)))

    fuel_channel_placement = psf.regen.SurfacePlacement(n_channel_positions=params["fuel_channel_count"],)
    nozzle_channel_placement = psf.regen.SurfacePlacement(
        n_channel_positions=params["nozzle_channel_count"],
        helix_angle=area_preserving_helix,
    )

    fuel_chamber_pass = psf.regen.CoolingCircuit(
        name="Fuel Chamber Pass",
        contour=contour,
        coolant_transport=fuel_transport,
        cross_section=cross_section_squared,
        span=[0.1, -1.0],
        placement=fuel_channel_placement,
        walls=[copper_wall],
        roughness=params["copper_roughness_height"],
        channel_height=fuel_channel_height,
        hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier=params[
            "fuel_hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier"
        ],
    )

    ox_nozzle_pass_outbound = psf.regen.CoolingCircuit(
        name="Oxidizer Nozzle Pass Outbound",
        contour=contour,
        coolant_transport=ox_transport,
        cross_section=cross_section_squared,
        span=ox_outbound_span,
        placement=nozzle_channel_placement,
        walls=[copper_wall],
        roughness=params["copper_roughness_height"],
        channel_height=ox_channel_height,
        hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier=params[
            "ox_outbound_hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier"
        ],
    )

    ox_nozzle_pass_return = psf.regen.CoolingCircuit(
        name="Oxidizer Nozzle Pass Return",
        contour=contour,
        coolant_transport=ox_transport,
        cross_section=cross_section_squared,
        span=ox_return_span,
        placement=nozzle_channel_placement,
        walls=[copper_wall],
        roughness=params["copper_roughness_height"],
        channel_height=ox_channel_height,
        hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier=params[
            "ox_return_hot_gas_surface_area_multiplier"
        ],
    )

    return psf.regen.ThrustChamber(
        contour=contour,
        combustion_transport=aerothermodynamics,
        cooling_circuits=[fuel_chamber_pass, ox_nozzle_pass_outbound, ox_nozzle_pass_return],
        h_gas_corr=1.0,
        h_cold_corr=1.0,
        n_nodes=100,
    )

def setup_initial_stations(params, thrust_chamber):
    """Create the initial station guesses used by the full-cycle solver."""

    stations = {}
    mdot_fu_est = thrust_chamber.combustion_transport.mdot_fu
    stations["fu_engine_in"]            = psf.network.Station(params["p_tank_fu"], params["T_tank_fu"], mdot_fu_est*0.6,)
    stations["fu_pump_in"]              = psf.network.Station(stations["fu_engine_in"].p, stations["fu_engine_in"].T, mdot_fu_est*0.6,)
    stations["fu_pump_out"]             = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.4, params["T_tank_fu"] + 10, mdot_fu_est*0.6,)
    stations["fu_shaft_recirc"]         = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.4, params["T_tank_fu"] + 10, 0.1,)
    stations["fu_regen_duct_in"]        = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.4, params["T_tank_fu"] + 10, mdot_fu_est*0.6,)
    stations["fu_regen_in"]             = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.5, params["T_tank_fu"] + 10, mdot_fu_est*0.6,)
    stations["fu_regen_out"]            = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.4, params["T_tank_fu"] + 250, mdot_fu_est*0.6,)
    stations["fu_turbine_inlet_split"]  = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.3, params["T_tank_fu"] + 250, mdot_fu_est,)
    stations["fu_bypass_valve"]         = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.3, params["T_tank_fu"] + 250, mdot_fu_est,)
    stations["fu_turbine_in"]           = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.2, params["T_tank_fu"] + 250, mdot_fu_est,)
    stations["fu_turbine_out"]          = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.1, params["T_tank_fu"] + 200, mdot_fu_est,)
    stations["fu_turbine_outlet_merge"] = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.1, params["T_tank_fu"] + 200, mdot_fu_est,)
    stations["fu_injector_plenum"]      = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.1, params["T_tank_fu"] + 200, mdot_fu_est,)
    stations["fu_chamber_in"]           = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"], params["T_tank_fu"] + 200, mdot_fu_est,)

    ox_regen_flow_fraction = float(params["ox_regen_flow_fraction"])
    if not 0.0 < ox_regen_flow_fraction < 1.0:
        raise ValueError("ox_regen_flow_fraction must be strictly between 0 and 1")

    mdot_ox_est = thrust_chamber.combustion_transport.mdot_ox
    mdot_ox_main_est = mdot_ox_est * 0.8
    mdot_ox_regen_est = mdot_ox_main_est * ox_regen_flow_fraction
    mdot_ox_direct_est = mdot_ox_main_est - mdot_ox_regen_est
    mdot_ox_bypass_est = mdot_ox_regen_est * params["zeta_ox_turbine_bypass"]
    mdot_ox_turbine_est = mdot_ox_regen_est - mdot_ox_bypass_est
    stations["ox_engine_in"]            = psf.network.Station(params["p_tank_ox"], params["T_tank_ox"], mdot_ox_est*0.8,)
    stations["ox_pump_in"]              = psf.network.Station(stations["ox_engine_in"].p, stations["ox_engine_in"].T, mdot_ox_est*0.8,)
    stations["ox_stage1_pump_out"]      = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.3, params["T_tank_ox"] + 10, mdot_ox_est*0.8,)
    stations["ox_shaft_recirc"]         = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.3, params["T_tank_ox"] + 10, 0.1,)
    stations["ox_main_flow"]            = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.3, params["T_tank_ox"] + 10, mdot_ox_main_est,)
    stations["ox_direct_branch"]        = psf.network.Station(params["p_c"] * 1.3, params["T_tank_ox"] + 10, mdot_ox_direct_est,)

    tab_cooling.add_figure(

            plot_hot=True,
            plot_coolant_wall=True,
            plot_interfaces=True,

    )
    tab_cooling.add_figure(psf.viz.PlotCoolantTemperature(*ordered_cooling_data))

            cooling_data["oxidizer_nozzle_return"],
